(() => { const v = document.querySelector(".pzp-pc video"); const b = v.currentTime; v.currentTime = v.seekable.start(0) + 2; return "rewind " + b.toFixed(1) + " -> " + v.currentTime.toFixed(1); })()

(() => { const v = document.querySelector(".pzp-pc video"); document.querySelector(".live_time_button")?.click(); if (v.seekable.end(0) - v.currentTime > 10) v.currentTime = v.seekable.end(0) - 1; return "live " + v.currentTime.toFixed(1); })()
